B.depoimento:
I trained two fresh spearmen at Barcelona, then sent three spearmen to capture Tarragona and two archers to seize Girona.
Both attacks succeeded, bringing our total to three villages under control.
B.plano:
Next turn, hold the newly taken villages and consider pushing toward Zaragoza or building more archers to counter spearmen.
Remember to keep Barcelona's garrison above 50 to deter enemy raids.
Do not waste knights on low-value targets.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent all spearmen to Santarem and all archers to Evora, leaving the knights to guard Lisboa. I postponed recruitment to focus on the imminent assault.
A.plano: Next turn, our armies will arrive at Santarem and Evora to capture them. Keep the knights in Lisboa as a reserve and watch for any enemy moves. Do not split forces further or build new troops until we secure these villages.

B.depoimento: Built two spearmen in Barcelona. Sent Girona's two archers to capture Castellon. Secured a fourth village while holding all existing ones.
B.plano: Next turn, hold Castellon and reinforce Barcelona with the newly built spearmen. Prepare a combined push toward Zaragoza using forces from Barcelona and Tarragona. Keep Barcelona's garrison above 50 to deter enemy raids. Avoid splitting armies unnecessarily.

A.depoimento: We sent all four spearmen from Santarem to take Coimbra, and we trained a new knight and archer in Lisboa to strengthen our forces for future offensives.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to have captured Coimbra with a small spearman garrison. Reinforce Coimbra and our interior villages, continue building troops in Lisboa, and prepare to expand toward other neutrals while watching for enemy movements.

B.depoimento:
This turn I built spearmen in all three villages.
I also sent reinforcements from Barcelona to Tarragona and Girona.
These moves set up our forces for next turn's attacks.
B.plano:
Next turn, use the arriving archers to assault Castellon.
Reinforce Tarragona and Girona for pushes on Zaragoza and Huesca.
Continue building spear at Barcelona to raise garrison above 50.
Avoid splitting armies unnecessarily.

A.depoimento: I ordered the construction of new troops in my villages and sent armies to take the neutral villages of Badajoz, Faro, and Porto. My forces are marching now, ready to secure these towns next turn while I hold the interior.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to have captured Badajoz, Faro, and Porto, increasing our held villages to 7. We will reinforce Coimbra and Lisboa with the newly built troops, continue producing knights and archers in Lisboa for future offensives toward Salamanca and the enemy capital, and keep watch for any enemy movements.

B.depoimento: This turn I raised spearmen in Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona, then sent four spears from each to seize Zaragoza and Huesca. I also reinforced Castellon with two spears from Barcelona. Our front expands while the homeland stays defended.
B.plano: Next turn, consolidate garrisons in Zaragoza and Huesca, prepare to push toward Valencia and Teruel. Continue building spears in Barcelona to maintain a strong reserve. Do not split forces further than needed for current fronts. Keep an eye on enemy movements toward our interior.

A.depoimento:
Built one archer and one spearman in Lisboa.
Sent two spearmen from Santarem and one spearman from Lisboa to Coimbra to strengthen its garrison.
The archers from Evora remain en route to Porto.
A.plano:
Reinforce Coimbra with troops from Santarem and Lisboa.
Continue building archers and spearmen in Lisboa for future knight production.
Prepare to launch a combined assault on Porto next turn using arriving archers and local forces.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona, and reinforced Castellon with two spears. My villages remain secure, and I am stockpiling troops for a future push toward the neutral village of Teruel.
B.plano: Next turn, continue building archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona. Begin moving archers to Castellon to assemble a force of at least 6 archers + 1 knight for an attack on Teruel. Keep spears in Zaragoza and Huesca for defense. Do not split forces further than needed.

A.depoimento: This turn I marched six spearmen from Coimbra to take Porto, and ordered new recruits in every town to strengthen my army.
A.plano: Next turn, send knights from Coimbra to capture Salamanca. Continue building troops in all villages. Do not split forces; keep enough defenders.

B.depoimento: Sent Barcelona's three knights to seize Valencia, winning the village.\nBuilt two archers and a knight at Barcelona to replenish forces for upcoming expansions.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce Valencia with new troops.\nContinue building archers/knights in Barcelona and other villages.\nAim to capture Teruel using available or newly built forces.

A.depoimento:
This turn I ordered construction of archers in Lisboa,
knights in Santarem, Evora, Badajoz, and Faro,
and an archer in Coimbra,
strengthening our forces for future offensives.
A.plano:
Continue building troops in all villages to increase forces.
Prepare to attack neutral villages once we have sufficient armies.
Do not split forces; keep garrisons strong.

B.depoimento: Sent 4 spearmen from Castellon to Valencia to reinforce. Built spearmen in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Zaragoza, and Huesca to increase our spearman forces.
B.plano: Next turn: accumulate spearmen in Valencia (incoming from Castellon + newly built) to reach 6, then send to Murcia to capture. Continue building spearmen in other villages for future attacks.

A.depoimento: Launched attacks on four neutral villages with tailored troop compositions. Reinforced our armies with new knights and a spearman. Maintained strong defensive garrisons across our holdings.
A.plano: Send focused forces to capture Salamanca, Toledo, Vigo, Sevilha this turn. Build knights in most villages to replenish stocks; Porto builds a spearman. Keep remaining archers and knights as garrison. Do not attack the enemy capital yet.

A.depoimento: Launched attacks on five neutral villages with mixed forces of knights, archers, and spearmen. Built new troops in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro, and Porto. Awaiting results of assaults.
A.plano: Send forces to capture Vigo, Sevilha, Cordoba, Madrid, Teruel this turn. Build archers and spearmen to replenish home garrisons. Keep some troops in each home village for defense. Do not attack the enemy capital yet.

B.depoimento: Secured Teruel and Murcia with focused attacks. Built a strong reserve of knights across our holdings. Ready to push further next turn.
B.plano: Captured Teruel and Murcia this turn. Next turn aim to take Pamplona and Madrid using newly built knights and archers. Must reinforce new villages and continue stockpiling counters.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on bolstering my archer production across the realm while shifting spearmen and knights toward Madrid to fortify our central position. I also dispatched a knight from Badajoz to Toledo to reinforce our western flank. No attacks were launched this turn as I prioritize defense and buildup.
A.plano: Hold at least one troop in each village. Build archers to strengthen future attacks. Send reinforcements to Madrid and prepare to take Burgos next turn. Avoid attacking Zaragoza or the enemy capital until we have superior forces.

B.depoimento: We reinforced Teruel with spearmen and knights from Zaragoza, Valencia, and Castellon, and built spearmen across our realms to prepare for future counter-offensives.
B.plano: Defend Teruel with reinforcements from Zaragoza, Valencia, and Castellon. Build spearmen in all villages to stockpile counters. Hold positions; avoid attacks this turn due to insufficient force.

A.depoimento:
Built archers in most villages.
Sent three knights from Madrid to capture Burgos.
Sent three archers from Cordoba to capture Valencia.
Sent two knights from Toledo to reinforce Teruel.
A.plano:
Hold at least one troop in each village.
Build archers to strengthen future attacks.
Capture Burgos and Valencia while reinforcing Teruel and Madrid.
Avoid attacking Zaragoza or the enemy capital until we have superior forces.

B.depoimento: Built 2 spearmen in each village. Marched Huesca's full garrison to Pamplona, sent Tarragona troops to bolster Castellon, and moved Girona troops to Barcelona. Existing armies en route to Murcia and Teruel should secure those villages next turn.
B.plano: Build spearmen in all villages to stockpile counters. Send Huesca force to take Pamplona, reinforce Castellon and Barcelona. Avoid attacking enemy capitals this turn; focus on securing borders and preparing for next turn's captures.

A.depoimento: This turn we ordered archers from Madrid and Toledo to assault Burgos, and a contingent from Sevilha to march on Teruel. Across our realms we recruited new archers to strengthen our armies. We hold our lines and prepare for the next push.
A.plano: Continue building archers in all villages to stockpile for future offensives. Keep at least one troop in each village. Press Burgos with archers from Madrid and Toledo while sending a Sevilha force to threaten Teruel. Avoid attacking Zaragoza or the enemy capital until we have a clear superiority.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen built in every capable village to strengthen our garrisons. I dispatched Zaragoza's available spearmen and knight to attack Pamplona, aiming to capture the neutral stronghold. The Huesca contingent continues its march and will arrive next turn to reinforce.
B.plano: Build spearmen in all villages to boost defense and stockpile counters. Keep the Huesca force en route to Pamplona and follow up with Zaragoza's attack to secure the neutral village. Avoid splitting forces or attacking enemy capitals this turn; focus on consolidating borders and preparing for next turn's expansion.

A.depoimento: Built archers in all productive villages to stockpile for future offensives. Sent three archers from Toledo toward Teruel to prepare for a decisive strike next turn.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Teruel with 6 archers (3 from Sevilha already marching + 3 from Toledo). Keep at least one troop in each village to retain control. Do not attempt Zaragoza, Murcia, or Pamplona attacks this turn due to insufficient forces.

B.depoimento: Statement: Ordered a knight from Pamplona to capture Burgos and a knight from Castellon to take Toledo. Sent spearmen from Valencia and Zaragoza to bolster Teruel’s defenses. Built spearmen across all villages and added an archer in Barcelona to ready for a future Madrid assault.
B.plano: Plan: Secure Burgos and Toledo next turn while reinforcing Teruel against the incoming enemy force. Build spearmen everywhere for defense and add an archer in Barcelona to prepare a future strike on Madrid. Avoid attacking the enemy capital or splitting forces unnecessarily.

A.depoimento: Built two archers in each of our thirteen villages. Sent Vigo's knight to capture Burgos. Sent archers from Madrid to Toledo and from Sevilha to Cordoba to strengthen our borders.
A.plano: Next turn, continue building archers in all villages. Reinforce Toledo and Cordoba with additional archers from interior. Prepare to attack Zaragoza or Murcia using combined forces from Madrid and Sevilha. Keep at least one troop in each village.

B.depoimento: Statement: This turn I sent a strong force from Teruel to seize Toledo, dispatched spearmen from Tarragona and Huesca to strengthen Zaragoza, and ordered the construction of spearmen in all my holdings to fortify my position.
B.plano: Plan: Capture Toledo to gain a new village and threaten Madrid. Reinforce Zaragoza with spearmen from Tarragona and Huesca for future offensives. Build two spearmen in every village to boost defenses. Avoid splitting forces or attacking the enemy capital directly.

A.depoimento: This turn we trained archers across our realms and marched a mixed force from Madrid toward Zaragoza. We aim to seize the enemy’s forward stronghold and expand our control. May our arrows find their mark.
A.plano: Continue building archers in all villages to stockpile forces. Reinforce Toledo and Cordoba with archers from interior. Prepare to attack Zaragoza or Murcia using combined forces from Madrid and Sevilha. Keep at least one troop in each village.

B.depoimento: Strengthened our border villages with new knights and sent reinforcements to Murcia. Our armies are gathering to take Madrid, Toledo, Cordoba, and Vigo in the near future.
B.plano: Build knights in Zaragoza, Teruel, Murcia, Burgos to prepare attacks on Madrid, Toledo, Cordoba, Vigo. Send a knight from Pamplona to Murcia to reinforce its future assault. Avoid premature attacks; wait for forces to accumulate. Do not divert resources to archers or spears now.

A.depoimento: Turn 17: Sent Vigo's troops to capture Burgos and Cordoba's forces to take Murcia. Produced archers everywhere and a spearman in Coimbra. Secured two enemy villages, raising our total to 15.
A.plano: Hold Burgos and Murcia; reinforce Toledo with archers from Badajoz and interior for a future Teruel push; keep building archers; maintain at least one troop per village.

B.depoimento: This turn I focused on building up my forces: added knights at Teruel, Murcia, and Burgos, and archers at Barcelona. I held my lines and prepared for next turn's offensive.
B.plano: Next turn, attack Toledo with Teruel's knights, Vigo with Burgos' knights, and Madrid with Barcelona's archers. Hold all borders and reinforce as needed. Do not launch any other attacks this turn.

A.depoimento:
Built one archer in each of our villages to boost our forces.
Sent three archers from Madrid to Zaragoza, aiming to seize the enemy garrison.
Held all other villages, preserving at least one troop each.
A.plano: Capture Zaragoza with archers from Madrid; continue building archers in all villages; reinforce Toledo for future Teruel push; keep at least one troop per village.

B.depoimento: I launched a coordinated knight strike against the enemy's eastern holdings while fortifying my borders. May our blades find their mark and bring us closer to victory.
B.plano: Send knight forces from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, and Murcia to capture Madrid, Toledo, and Cordoba next turn. Build knights in Barcelona and Tarragona, spearmen in Zaragoza, and archer in Burgos to reinforce defenses. Do not attack Vigo or weaken Zaragoza's garrison.

A.depoimento:
Built 2 archers in each village.
Sent Badajoz's lone knight to reinforce Toledo.
Ready to face the enemy army arriving next turn.
A.plano:
Defend Toledo with the incoming knight.
Continue building archers in all villages.
Hold border villages.
Prepare to attack Teruel after securing Toledo.

B.depoimento:
This turn we captured Cordoba, Vigo, and Toledo after coordinated attacks.
We sent a probing force to Salamanca to weaken its garrison.
Our knights marched from Tarragona to reinforce Toledo as planned.
We ramped up knight production across the realm to sustain the offensive.
B.plano:
Consolidate recent gains by garrisoning Cordoba, Vigo, and Toledo with surviving troops.
Continue knight production in all villages to replace losses and strengthen defenses.
Prepare a stronger assault on Salamanca next turn using accumulated forces.
Avoid leaving border villages undefended; keep at least one unit in each.

B.depoimento: Launched successful attacks on Toledo and Cordoba using knight forces, securing two new villages; ordered knight and archer builds across our territories to replenish losses and strengthen defenses.
B.plano: Consolidate Toledo and Cordoba garrisons; continue knight production in all villages; prepare to attack Vigo and Salamanca next turn with accumulated forces; keep at least one unit in each border village; avoid overextending.

A.depoimento: I ordered spearmen production in every village, launched attack forces to seize Toledo, Cordoba, and Madrid, and marched archers from Porto to Vigo to prepare for the upcoming assault on Burgos.
A.plano:
Capture Toledo, Cordoba, and Madrid this turn.
Reinforce Vigo with archers from Porto for a Burgos attack next turn.
Build spearmen in all villages to strengthen counter‑knight capability.
Keep sufficient garrison in each border village to deter enemy counter‑attacks.

B.depoimento: Ordered mass production of knights and spears, and transferred all interior troops to strengthen our border garrisons for upcoming offensive.
B.plano: Reinforce border villages with troops from interior; build knights and spears in Burgos; prepare to attack Salamanca, Badajoz, Vigo next turn; keep at least one garrison in each border village; do not attack this turn due to insufficient forces.

A.depoimento: We captured Murcia, reinforced Toledo and Madrid, shifted interior troops to strengthen Vigo for a future Burgos attack, and built spearmen in every village to improve our counter‑knight readiness.
A.plano: Next turn, build more spearmen, march troops from Vigo to Burgos to capture it, reinforce Valencia from Murcia, and keep garrisons in Toledo and Madrid against enemy armies arriving.

B.depoimento: Sent knight squads from Madrid, Toledo, Burgos and interior villages to take Salamanca, Cordoba, Badajoz and Vigo. Recruited three archers in Burgos to bolster defenses. Held remaining troops as garrison. Preparing to seize a fifth village next turn.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca, Cordoba, Badajoz, and Vigo with knight-heavy forces. Keep interior knights as reserve. Build three archers in Burgos for future defense. Do not attack Sevilha this turn due to insufficient knights.

A.depoimento: Sent reinforcements to Vigo and Cordoba, attacked Valencia and Salamanca with spearmen, and built spearmen in all our villages to boost future strength.
A.plano: Keep garrisons strong, reinforce Vigo and Cordoba for incoming enemy armies, prepare to capture Valencia next turn, continue building spearmen, avoid risky attacks on Toledo or Burgos for now.

B.depoimento:
Deployed veteran knights from Barcelona, Tarragona, Castellon, Madrid, and Toledo to reinforce Valencia and Burgos.
Recruited additional spearmen, archers, and knights in home villages.
Readied the army for a swift strike against enemy border towns.
B.plano:
Next turn, launch attacks on Murcia from Valencia and on Vigo from Burgos using knight-heavy forces.
Keep interior garrisons strong and build archers in Burgos for defense.
Do not overextend; preserve reserves for counterattacks.

A.depoimento: Ordered spearmen production in every village. Sent large spearmen groups from Lisboa, Evora, Porto, Coimbra, Faro, and Sevilha to Salamanca (arriving in 2 turns). Sent 6 spearmen from Murcia to Valencia to seize it next turn.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca and Valencia by overwhelming them with spearmen forces arriving in 1-2 turns. Build spearmen in all villages to replenish garrisons. Avoid risky attacks on Toledo or Burgos due to strong defenses.

B.depoimento: Sent a knight from Teruel to Valencia, reinforced Salamanca with spears and archers from Madrid, and forwarded spears to Teruel for later Valencia support. Built archers in Madrid, Valencia, and Salamanca, and spears in Burgos, Toledo, and Teruel.
B.plano: Next turn Salamanca will have extra spears and archers to defend the two incoming enemy armies and to launch an attack on Coimbra. Valencia will receive a knight from Teruel and have new archers for future offensive actions. Keep interior garrisons strong and continue building archers in Madrid and spears in Burgos for defense.

A.depoimento:
I built spearmen in every village to stock up.
I dispatched a Badajoz force of 8 spears and 10 archers toward Salamanca.
Existing marches continue to harass Salamanca, Toledo, and Valencia.
Vigo will soon receive reinforcements from Faro.
A.plano:
Build spearmen in all villages to replenish garrisons.
Send Badajoz's 8 spearmen and 10 archers to Salamanca to overwhelm.
Keep existing marches to pressure enemy borders.
Prepare to reinforce Vigo after its arriving army.

B.depoimento: Sent 3 knights from Salamanca to capture Coimbra and 20 knights from Burgos to seize Vigo. Sent 20 spearmen from Madrid to bolster Salamanca's defenses. Built archers and knights across the realm, keeping Valencia's garrison strong. Ready to push forward next turn.
B.plano: Hold Valencia with archers; reinforce Salamanca with spearmen from Madrid before enemy armies arrive. Attack Coimbra with knights from Salamanca and Vigo with knights from Burgos. Build archers and knights in most villages to prepare for next offensives. Do not attack Murcia this turn to preserve Valencia.

A.depoimento: I launched a full assault on Vigo with Porto's troops, marched archers from Cordoba and Murcia toward Valencia, and flooded the front with spearmen from inland. My villages began producing spearmen to replace losses.
A.plano: Capture Vigo this turn with Porto's garrison. Reinforce front lines: send spearmen inland to Coimbra and Porto, archers toward Valencia via Cordoba and Murcia. Build spearmen in all villages to replenish garrisons. Next turn, prepare to assault Valencia with massed archers and defend against enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: We seized Murcia and Porto, bolstered Salamanca and Madrid, and trained archers across the realm. Enemy columns march on Salamanca, but our defenses stand.
B.plano: Hold Salamanca with reinforced garrison; use Madrid to prepare assaults on Coimbra and Badajoz next turn; continue building archers everywhere; avoid splitting forces unnecessarily.

A.depoimento: Statement: This turn I launched a strong assault on Toledo using all archers and spearmen from Badajoz, supported by spearmen from Santarem and Sevilha. I also ordered spearmen builds in every village to strengthen defenses. My goal is to secure Toledo and prepare for further offensives.
A.plano: Plan: Hold Toledo after expected capture; reinforce it with troops from Santarem and Sevilha. Keep Coimbra and Badajoz defended with at least 10 troops each. Build spearmen in all villages to replenish garrisons. Next turn, prepare to assault Valencia or Murcia with archers.

B.depoimento: Launched two assaults from Madrid towards Coimbra and Cordoba, splitting our spear, archer, and knight forces. Ordered archer production in all villages to boost income. Held our defensive lines while the marches begin.
B.plano: Send forces from Madrid to Coimbra and Cordoba to capture two enemy villages. Continue building archers everywhere to strengthen economy. Prepare to reinforce Madrid and border villages next turn. Watch for enemy reinforcements on Badajoz.

A.depoimento: We sent 11 spearmen from Coimbra to attack Porto, reinforced Coimbra and Badajoz with troops from interior villages, and strengthened Cordoba with archers and spearmen from Toledo and Sevilha. We also began building spearmen in all villages and added archers in Toledo and Cordoba.
A.plano: Hold Coimbra and Badajoz with at least 10 troops each after reinforcements. Assess Porto attack outcome next turn. Continue building spearmen everywhere; add archers in Toledo and Cordoba. Prepare to assault Teruel or Murcia with spearmen if Porto succeeds.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent Pamplona's army to take Badajoz, redirected troops to strengthen Teruel and Madrid, and ordered spearmen production across the realm to fortify our holdings while our marches press toward Coimbra and Cordoba.
B.plano: Capture Badajoz with Pamplona's forces. Reinforce Teruel and Madrid with Valencia, Castellon, Zaragoza, Burgos. Build spearmen in all villages to boost defense. Keep existing marches to Coimbra and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: I reinforced Cordoba and Badajoz with troops from Toledo, Sevilha, Santarem, and Faro, while building archers in every village and adding spearmen in Toledo and Cordoba to strengthen defenses and prepare for future attacks.
A.plano: Hold Cordoba and Badajoz with reinforcements. Keep a troop in Sevilha for local defense. Build archers in all villages and extra spearmen in Toledo and Cordoba to prepare for future offensives. Avoid sending troops to Coimbra this turn; focus on defense and resource buildup.

B.depoimento:
Launched attacks on Toledo and Cordoba with forces from Teruel and Madrid.
Sent spearmen reinforcements to Teruel from interior villages.
Ordered spearmen builds in every village to strengthen defenses.
Maintained ongoing marches.
B.plano:
Capture Toledo and Cordoba this turn.
Reinforce Teruel with spearmen from Valencia, Castellon, Zaragoza, Burgos.
Build spearmen in all villages to increase defense.
Keep existing marches to Coimbra and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on fortifying my borders. I built archers everywhere and added knights to Badajoz and Sevilha. I sent reinforcements to bolster Badajoz against the incoming enemy army and strengthened Santarem to hold off Coimbra. Cordoba received an extra archer from Sevilha. I held off on offensives until my forces are ready.
A.plano: Build archers in all villages and knights in Badajoz and Sevilha to strengthen defenses. Reinforce Badajoz with troops from Faro and Sevilha, and Santarem with troops from Lisboa and Evora. Send an archer from Sevilha to Cordoba for extra defense. Avoid attacking Coimbra or Toledo this turn due to insufficient force.

B.depoimento:
Built spearmen in every village to boost defense.
Sent 5 spearmen from Teruel to Toledo, 1 spear from Valencia to Murcia, 1 spear from Porto to Coimbra, 3 archers from Vigo to Coimbra, and 5 spear from Madrid to Salamanca.
Maintained all ongoing marches; no enemy armies spotted.
Preparing to capture Cordoba next turn via Toledo.
B.plano:
Reinforce Toledo with spearmen from Teruel for future attack on Cordoba.
Send additional spear/archer to Murcia, Coimbra, Salamanca to bolster defenses.
Build spearmen in all villages to increase defensive strength.
Keep existing marches (Madrid->Toledo, Pamplona->Badajoz, Castellon/Zaragoza/Burgos->Teruel) unchanged.
